scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: npx concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:https: npx concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend:https"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.type-check: npm run type-check --prefix backend && npm run type-check --prefix frontend
